response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.cnt - avgc.a) AS avg_excess FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avgc WHERE c.cnt > avgc.a
